name: Trainual
description: Trainual is a training and operations platform that combines standard operating procedures, role-based onboarding, and an AI-powered knowledge search so teams can document processes once and deliver consistent training at scale.
best_for: Positioned for business owners, operations leaders, and team managers in field-based, remote, and multi-location organizations, including healthcare, construction, home services, agencies, law firms, and real estate.
features: Role-based training paths and onboarding programs
AI-powered knowledge search and Q&A assistant
Testing, tracking, and compliance reporting with e-signatures
Pre-built courses on essential business topics
Roles and responsibilities mapping across an org chart
Meeting management with agendas and action tracking

alternatives.name: Guru
alternatives.description: An enterprise knowledge-management platform that organizes and continuously verifies company information.

alternatives.name: Tettra
alternatives.description: An AI-powered internal knowledge base built around a Slack-first workflow for answering team questions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a lightweight internal wiki rather than a full training suite

alternatives.name: Confluence
alternatives.description: Atlassian's team workspace for documentation, meeting notes, and internal knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already standardized on Atlassian tools

pricing.starting_price: Pricing varies by team size and required features; request a demo for a current quote

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Centralized documentation and training. Includes 2 GB video storage and 30-day version history; individual training paths, uploaded video hosting, and e-signatures are not included.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Adds individual training paths, uploaded video hosting, 15 GB video storage, 300 e-signatures/year, org/accountability charts, and 90-day version history.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Adds unlimited video storage/version history/e-signatures, custom branding/domain, SSO, training-path templates, and 15 GB SCORM storage.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Adds API/custom integration support, SOC 2 documentation access, extended implementation/migration, organizational rollout support, priority support, and a designated Customer Success Manager.

cons: Trainual does not publish one universal self-serve subscription price on its main pricing page; the current quote depends on team size and required features.
Core is limited to 2 GB of video storage and 30 days of version history; uploaded video hosting, individual training paths, and e-signatures require Pro or higher.
SSO and a custom domain require Premium or Enterprise, while API access and custom integration support are reserved for Enterprise.
Trainual's annual-plan agreement charges a full year upfront and automatically renews annually unless changed or cancelled under the account terms.
